question.text: The facility for migration of VCFs to SEBI (AIF) Regulations was available until:

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the migration facility from SEBI (VCF) Regulations 1996 to SEBI (AIF) Regulations was available only till July 19, 2025. The workbook repeats this July 19, 2025 date in the registration-requirements discussion. The Trap: A separate date — July 19, 2026 — applies to the additional liquidation period for migrated VCF schemes; it is not the migration deadline itself. Note: Both dates appear in the workbook but serve different purposes (migration vs additional liquidation period for migrated schemes).
